svg.title: Syrian hamster
svg.desc: Golden Syrian hamster with a compact body, short tail, rounded ears, cheek region, and small grasping forepaws. Biological basis: Syrian hamsters support studies of metabolism, circadian biology, reproduction, oncology, and respiratory viral infection.
